# Fixture Font Provenance

The fixture fonts are copied from the official Liberation Fonts 2.1.5 TTF
release archive:

`https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts/files/7261482/liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5.tar.gz`

The archive SHA-256 is:

`7191c669bf38899f73a2094ed00f7b800553364f90e2637010a69c0e268f25d0`

The source release is version 2.1.5, published by the Liberation Fonts project
under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The license and copyright notice are
included in `LICENSE-OFL.txt`. The license permits bundling and embedding the
fonts with software when the license and copyright notice are redistributed.

Committed files and SHA-256 checksums:

| File | Source archive path | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LiberationSans-Regular.ttf` | `liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf` | `76d04c18ea243f426b7de1f3ad208e927008f961dc5945e5aad352d0dfde8ee8` |
| `LiberationSerif-Regular.ttf` | `liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5/LiberationSerif-Regular.ttf` | `058ea80864aef09a23f45cbec2bb5400bc3dfbdea01c3f10538a21fcb497fb74` |

The generator reads these committed files only. It does not download fonts or
inspect host font directories.
